name: Sumire
source:
The mother of Felicita and does fortunetelling for the Family with her Judgement Arcana (#20). Everyone in the family calls her "Mamma". She has a mysterious air around her, but she is a refined lady. Like Mondo, though, she has a doting aspect to her personality for her daughter, despite giving her a strict upbringing. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/La_storia_della_Arcana_Famiglia#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
